errors.text_span: Das in dem Bild enthaltene Diagramm ist im grafischen Bereich vollständig verschwommen und unkenntlich.
errors.evidence: The diagram is clear and legible, with visible axes, labels, and data points. The claim that the diagram is 'vollständig verschwommen und unkenntlich' is incorrect.
The machine-generated description does not mention that the chart illustrates the percentage of employed individuals by age group and migration status.
The description omits the x-axis label ('Alter'), its linear scale (20 to 70), and tick intervals (10).
The description omits the y-axis label ('Anteil Erwerbstätige in %'), its linear scale (0 to 100), and tick intervals (20).

The description does not mention the presence of four distinct lines in the chart, their colors, or their corresponding labels in the legend ('ohne Migrationshintergrund', 'in Deutschland geboren', 'zugewandert bis 2009', 'zugewandert seit 2010').
The description does not describe the trends and values of the lines, such as the black line starting at 60%, peaking at 85%, and falling to 10% by age 70.
The description does not mention the gray line's similar trend to the black line, with smaller fluctuations.
The description does not mention the light blue line starting at 35%, fluctuating between 60% and 80%, and falling to 10% by age 70.
The description does not mention the dark blue line starting at 40%, peaking at 50%, and falling to nearly 0% by age 70.
